name: Marry Me in NYC
overview: New York City is one of the world's top tourist destinations and is becoming an increasingly popular destination for couples to hold their weddings. Gino Filippone, a former tour guide who knows his way around New York, is the go-to guy for couples who want to tie the knot in the Big Apple. Through his company, Ultimate USA Weddings, Filippone helps couples plan their dream weddings in such iconic locations as the Empire State Building, Rockefeller Center's Top of the Rock, Central Park and the Brooklyn Bridge. And he often does it while adhering to small budgets, something that's difficult to do in New York.
